summary: Calidi Biotherapeutics filed an 8-K reporting a registered direct offering under its effective Form S-3 shelf. On September 17, 2026, the company signed a stock purchase agreement with accredited investors and/or qualified institutional buyers to sell 1,025,640 common shares at $1.17 per share, grossing roughly $1.2 million before expenses, with closing on September 21, 2026. No underwriter, placement agent or commissions were used; proceeds fund working capital and general corporate purposes. The agreement imposes a 45-day issuance standstill, and officers and directors signed 60-day lock-ups.
